We made it back to the academy past 8:00 AM. I could barely sleep and my whole body ached,
yet strangely enough, I felt hardly any mental fatigue.
A satisfying match?
Even so, I just couldn't give up on becoming "chanko nabe" without actually turning into a pot of soup. So I read books, came up with recipes...

Hot pots and soups bring out tons of sweet, delicious broth,
and hamburger steaks and fried chicken turn out super juicy!
Startled by the wild tale, I listened closer to hear the rest—
That's why he's smiling from the bottom of his heart. I'm sure of it.

Ever since I was little, Mommy and Daddy taught me all sorts of things~.
They're both really amazing cooks, you know~.

Amazing! Chanko nabe is so amazing!
Sumo wrestlers are incredible because chanko nabe is incredible, huh~!
...Huh?
And then one day, while I was watching sumo on TV like always—

—Wait, huh? But if I become chanko nabe,
I won't be able to eat chanko nabe anymore...?

Mommy, that sumo wrestler lost
and was crying just a moment ago, so why is he smiling now~?

She certainly had a unique way of looking at things,
but I felt like I had touched upon the very core of who she was.
Yep. Huh? Didn't I mention it before~?

Well now.
It's probably because he was able to have a truly satisfying bout~.
You see... let's see now...

I've got a mock race today,
but you should take it easy and get plenty of rest, okay, Trainer~?
Here you go! Canned mackerel seasoned rice, all for you☆

Smells so good~! Looks like it turned out great~.
There's still plenty left, so eat up and have a whole biiiig bunch, Trainer♪

An Umamusume that opponents can clash against with all their might!
Someone who leaves everyone feeling satisfied and smiling, win or lose!
You know, this is the first time I've ever put it into words like this~. Up until now, I just thought racing was fun because it made everyone smile, you know?

I see... He was satisfied, and that made him feel happy inside.
Kind of like... how you feel when you eat chanko nabe!

A sudden question crossed my mind. If that was the case, why did Hishi Akebono
choose to compete in races rather than become a chef?

"—Sumo wrestlers eat chanko nabe together every day.
That's how they fill their bellies, build up their strength, and get stronger."
You know, back then, I really wanted to become chanko nabe!
I came to Tracen Academy because I wanted to be like that~.

So just like the food my mom and dad make,
I want to become an Umamusume who can put a big smile on everyone's faces~.

"Especially after clashing with everything you've got, sharing chanko with your peers is truly special.
It satisfies your heart and body and brings a smile to your face. It makes you feel ready to give it your all again."
I was thinking about all that while running~. Ahahaha~!

It means giving it your absolute all and clashing until you're truly satisfied.
Your opponent has to be just as serious, so it's surprisingly hard to do.

The mixed rice was warm and gently seasoned, soothing my exhausted body.
First the deserted island, and now this—to think she could cook this well under such limited conditions...

Whenever people eat their cooking, it makes everyone smile.
Isn't that just amazing~?

Hishi Akebono was full of energy, looking completely unfazed by having spent the night outdoors.
She carried herself as if she had just woken up from a refreshing night of deep sleep.
Huh?

I want to be chanko nabe too! I wanna become chanko nabe,
eat chanko nabe together with everyone, and get all energized to do our best again!
Surprised you, huh? Hehe, it kind of surprised me too.

If you want to make people happy with food like your parents do,
going to culinary school would make more sense than Tracen Academy. When I told her that—
Ehehe~, thank you☆

And so, I figured if I could battle someone with everything I've got,
I might be able to become "chanko nabe" too~.

Phew~, we're finally back at the academy~.
Thanks for all your hard work, Trainer!

"—Man, they were seriously tough. I still wasn't on
their level yet. But... we clashed with everything we had!"
So yeah, I gave up on actually becoming chanko nabe, you know~?

While waiting for the first bus, Hishi Akebono took out a camp
stove and mess tin and cooked up some delicious mixed rice for us.

"Now, following the bout, we have a special feature on sumo stable chanko nabe.
We have former sumo wrestlers turned chefs joining us in the studio today."
